sentences.text:
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and the learned Government Advocate (Criminal Side) appearing for the first respondent- Police and perused the materials available on record.
3.On a perusal of the records, is seen that F.I.R in Crime No.70 of 2024 has been registered as against the petitioners for the offences under Section 66(D) of IT Act and Sections 406 and 420 of IPC by the third respondent/Police and they have sent a communication to the Bank to freeze the petitioners' account.

Further, it is seen that the second and third https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 19/06/2025 05:22:35 pm ) respondents are Karnataka Police.
The petitioners have filed this petition seeking to direct the second and third respondent-Police to de-freeze the petitioners' Accounts.
The first respondent-Police has nothing to do with this case.
Hence, this Court is not inclined to grant the relief as sought for by the petitioners in this writ petition.
However, the petitioners are at liberty to workout their remedy before the competent Civil Court.
4. With the abovesaid direction, this Writ Petition is dismissed.
No costs.
5. W.M.P.No.21925 of 2025 is ordered on payment of separate Court fees by each of the petitioners.
